svg.style: background:#0e1317; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, monospace; font-variant-ligatures: none; font-feature-settings: 'liga' 0, 'calt' 0; border-radius: 6px;
svg.title: Prompt Rules vs. Deterministic PreToolUse Guardrails
svg.desc: Comparison showing why prompt-only AGENTS.md rules degrade under context pressure while a PreToolUse Rust hook intercepts the command deterministically, refuses in 50 milliseconds, and teaches the agent the exact replacement Bazel target.
svg.text: Prompts Advise. PreToolUse Hooks Enforce — and Teach.
Why passive Markdown instructions break 40 turns into a task, and how agent-guard turns refusals into one-turn self-correction
BEFORE: ADVISORY PROMPT RULES (AGENTS.md)
1. Session Start
Agent loads AGENTS.md ("Always use bazel run //tools/git:commit,
never raw git commit, never git stash, never go test...").
Works cleanly for the first ~10 trivial tool calls.
2. Turn 40: Deep Debug + Context Pressure
Window fills with stack traces, diffs, and failing tests.
Pre-training habits ("git stash", "go test", "gh pr view")
outrank prose instructions sitting thousands of tokens back.
$ git stash && go test ./tools/worktree/...
3. Silent Side Effects in Live Repo
• git stash mutates the shared stash stack across every
parallel worktree (wiping another agent's uncommitted changes)
• go test skips Bazel hermetic toolchains & secret checks
• Human discovers leaked work or damaged state after the fact
✗ Probabilistic: obeys ~98% of calls — the other 2% break things
AFTER: DETERMINISTIC PRETOOLUSE HOOK (agent-guard)
1. Model Proposes Tool Call (Claude Code / Antigravity)
Bash / run_command: "git stash" or "gh pr view 4990"
Agent harness pauses execution and pipes tool JSON to hook.sh
2. Cached origin/main Rust Binary (~50 ms)
• Parses compound shell syntax, escapes, subshells & cwd scope
• Evaluates against origin/main's 31 policy categories + fails closed
• Never alters James's own interactive terminal sessions
Decision: DENY (or ALLOW in ~50 ms, logged to 0600 JSONL)
3. Refusal Teaches the Exact Replacement Command
Blocked by agent-guard: `gh pr view` must go through
Bazel in vitruvian-core. Use `bazel run //tools/agent-app
-- read pr view 4990`. If no target fits, stop and tell James.
self-corrects
✓ Next turn: agent runs the named Bazel target directly
Real result: 5,742 / 5,792 calls allowed cleanly; 50 habit violations caught
